nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X] (μ : OuterMeasure X), IsRadonOuterMeasure μ → ∀ (f : C_c(X, ℝ)) (C : ℝ), (∀ x, |f x| ≤ C) → |∫ x, f x ∂caratheodoryMeasure μ| ≤ (μ (tsupport f)).toReal * C

nodes.title: Diagonal subsequence for countably many bounded real sequences
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (ι : Type u) [Countable ι] (a : ℕ → ι → ℝ), (∀ i, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ k, |a k i| ≤ C) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ i, ∃ l : ℝ, Tendsto (fun k => a (φ k) i) atTop (𝓝 l)

nodes.title: Representation of positive linear functionals on C_c(X, ℝ) from Theorem 4.12
nodes.lean_statement: RieszPositive.{u} → ∀ (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X] (Λ : C_c(X, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ), (∀ f : C_c(X, ℝ), 0 ≤ f → 0 ≤ Λ f) → ∃ μ : OuterMeasure X, IsRadonOuterMeasure μ ∧ ∀ f : C_c(X, ℝ), Λ f = ∫ x, f x ∂caratheodoryMeasure μ

nodes.title: One subsequence along which all test-function integrals converge
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X] (μ : ℕ → OuterMeasure X), (∀ k, IsRadonOuterMeasure (μ k)) → (∀ K : Set X, IsCompact K → ⨆ k, μ k K < ∞) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ f : C_c(X, ℝ), ∃ l : ℝ, Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x, f x ∂caratheodoryMeasure (μ (φ k))) atTop (𝓝 l)
